Validation.heading: Before running
Validation.runtimeNote: This structure is valid, but this runtime refuses to run it:

codes.UNKNOWN_REFERENCE: Something refers to an item that does not exist.
codes.INVALID_PORT: This connection uses a port the node does not have.
codes.DUPLICATE_PORT_EDGE: An output leads to two places.
codes.CALLABLE_IN_CONTROL_FLOW: A callable agent is connected into the flow.
codes.ENTRY_INVALID: The flow must start at an agent outside any Loop.
codes.DEAD_END: This agent has no next step.
codes.DECISION_RULE: This decision's rule does not match its mode.
codes.DECISION_BRANCH_MISSING: A branch of this decision is not connected.
codes.LOOP_BOUNDARY: This connection crosses the Loop boundary outside its ports.
codes.CYCLE_OUTSIDE_LOOP: This connection closes a cycle. Use a Loop to repeat work.
codes.UNREACHABLE: The flow never reaches this node.
codes.NO_OUTPUT: The flow never reaches an Output.
codes.CAPABILITY_TARGET: Calls go from an agent to a callable agent.
codes.CAPABILITY_NOT_ALLOWED: The calling role is not allowed to make this call.
codes.DEPTH_EXCEEDED: This agent is only reachable beyond the delegation depth limit.
codes.BINDING_SOURCE: An input reads from a step that cannot provide it: {message}
codes.REVIEW_CONTRACT: A review decision must read a reviewer's output.
codes.UNKNOWN_MODEL_PROFILE: A role uses a model profile that is not configured.
codes.REVIEW_WITHOUT_CRITERIA: {node} does not get the criteria, so its review cannot check them.

guide.heading: Demo guide
guide.intro: Each step is checked off from what the simulated run actually recorded.

steps.delegate: Research hands two parts to Research Helpers. They appear under it in Executions.
steps.ask: The Writer asks the Source Responder a question and gets an answer.
steps.revise: The Reviewer asks for a revision, so the Writer runs a second round.
steps.steer: Optional: steer the round 2 Writer. Your instruction reaches its next request, not the draft it already submitted.
steps.finish: Approve the reviewed draft, then the final output.

guide.pauseAtRound2: Pause the run when the round 2 Writer starts

audit.name: Review an interface
audit.prompt: Review the specified interface with the bound design skills. Preserve its users, tasks and identity. Report observed issues, evidence and limitations. Do not infer browser or assistive-technology results from code. Produce a detailed report; a targeted review is not release approval.

tokens.name: Propose design tokens
tokens.prompt: Propose design tokens from the supplied product evidence. Reuse preferences already given. Use {askTool} only for missing decisions; distinguish AI delegation from a user choosing specific values. Record question/request IDs and where answers were used. The proposal is an artifact, not applied code.

verify.name: Verify a design change
verify.prompt: Verify the specified change with the bound {skill} skill. State targeted or release scope and limitations. Store the detailed report as an artifact and submit only the final review. Follow this review contract: {reviewContract}. Distinguish report validation, code checks and actual browser evidence.

Refusal.signin: The team's model is not connected. Sign in under Settings › Models, or send it with simulated agents.

Refusal.busy: Another run is working right now. Queue this request to start it afterwards.
Refusal.limit: The request is over this installation's limits (for example, referenced results are too large).

Refusal.network: The answer was lost on the way, so it is not known whether the request arrived. Sending again will not start a second run.

Harness.heading: Work styles
Harness.intro: Save skill, extension and tool selections as a revision. Apply it to a default or choose the new revision on a role.
Harness.localOnly: Work styles need the local Corral server.
Harness.sourceHint: A local resource folder, npm:package@1.2.3, or git:https://host/repository@commit. Discovery copies files without loading extensions.
Harness.noResources: No resources installed. Review a source to get started.
Harness.nativeWarning: Native extensions can access files, network and processes. Corral does not sandbox their direct actions. Only trust code you have reviewed.
Harness.skillScripts: Skill scripts are not executed automatically.
Harness.name: Work style name
Harness.toolsHint: Comma-separated names. Both role permissions and inherited restrictions apply. Native tool names are checked at runtime.
Harness.commandsHint: One extension command per line, for example /ponytail ultra. Commands run before the first model request. Reload and commands during execution are unsupported.
Harness.dynamic: Capability-dependent and dynamically registered tools are resolved at execution. Extension prompt changes are also recorded then.
Harness.defaultsHint: Personal → project → role. Stricter policy and tool restrictions win. Mandatory resources stay applied. Roles without a work style use the existing basic runtime.
Harness.pinned: Pinned revision {revision}; changes apply to the next run.
Harness.error: Could not save or validate this selection.
Harness.answerUnconfirmed: Answer delivery is unconfirmed. Check the pending request before trying again.
Harness.piHomeHint: Explicitly copy skills and extensions from {folder}. Credentials, settings and sessions are excluded. Install packages referenced only by Pi settings separately with a pinned version.
Harness.startupOnly: Startup only. Add this command in the role’s work style settings for a future run.
Harness.saveBeforePreview: Save your changes before previewing the settings that a run will use.
Harness.selectChecks: Select registered checks for this style
Harness.checkSelectionHint: Uncheck to inherit the parent selection. Selecting an empty list disables checks. Parent tool restrictions still apply.
Harness.noProjectChecks: No checks are registered for this project.
Harness.manageChecks: Register commands in work folder settings
Harness.checkTrustHint: Review the exact command before trusting its launch. It runs native code on this computer. A changed executable, script or lockfile requires another approval.
Harness.lspSetupHint: Register an installed stdio language server. Corral does not install servers or run shell commands. Launch trust is separate from selecting a server.
Harness.noProjectLsp: No language servers are registered for this project.
Harness.lspArgvHint: First line: executable. Following lines: one argument each, without shell quoting. Separate language IDs and file extensions with commas.
Harness.invalidLsp: Check the ID, command, language IDs, dot-prefixed file extensions and timeout (1–1800 seconds).
Harness.duplicateLsp: This server ID already exists. Edit its existing entry.
Harness.selectLsp: Select language servers for this style
Harness.lspSelectionHint: Uncheck to inherit the parent selection. An empty list disables language servers. The role also needs file read permission.
Harness.runStyleHint: Adds a final layer to the selected roles for this run only. Required resources and stricter tool restrictions remain. Saved team settings stay unchanged.
Harness.promptUnavailable: The extension prompt could not be loaded. Dismiss it or try again.
Harness.codemodeHint: Combines allowed tools in a JavaScript sandbox. Requires trusted native policy. At most two workers may run or shut down across executions. Direct model access from scripts is disabled.
Harness.mcpSetupHint: Register installed stdio servers or Streamable HTTP endpoints. Review launch trust and authentication separately. Native servers run outside an OS sandbox.
Harness.noProjectMcp: No MCP servers are registered for this project.
Harness.mcpArgvHint: First line: executable. Following lines: one argument each, without shell quoting. It runs in the session working copy.
Harness.invalidMcp: Check the lowercase server ID, executable or HTTPS endpoint, authentication fields and timeout (1–300 seconds). Loopback HTTP is allowed.
Harness.mcpAuthHint: Credentials are kept outside the workspace. Saved credentials do not confirm server connectivity. Changed endpoints or scopes require a separate sign-in.
Harness.mcpLoginFailed: Sign-in did not complete. Check server trust and scopes, then try again.
Harness.selectMcp: Select MCP servers for this style
Harness.mcpSelectionHint: Requires trusted native policy. Uncheck to inherit. Discover tools below and save the work style to apply your selection. Server selection alone grants no tools.
Harness.staticToolsHint: Definitions for the allowlist. Role permissions, working copies and selected targets can further restrict availability.
Harness.questionUnavailable: The question could not be loaded. Try again or cancel the run.
Harness.permissionPolicyHint: Saved rules apply to future runs. Deny takes precedence; allow never expands role or strict permissions. Use an exact descriptor from preview or a permission request.
Harness.skillDelivery: Complete skill bodies found in the provider payload
Harness.personalDefaultHint: Applies to future runs across projects on this server.
Harness.projectDefaultHint: Applies to future runs in the selected project.

Recipe.heading: Review recipe
Recipe.setupHint: Pin the criteria, reviewer and limits for this Loop. The candidate → reviewer → review decision stays in the existing graph.
Recipe.criteriaChanged: Criteria changed. Pin a new recipe revision before running.
Recipe.maxRepairs: Maximum repairs after the first attempt
Recipe.limitsHint: The first generation counts as an attempt. The smaller attempt/repair limit wins. Parent run limits also apply. Approval cannot extend these caps.
Recipe.checksHint: Select the same checks in the candidate role’s work style. Each launch still requires its own trust or approval.
Recipe.filesHint: Optional: one project-relative path per line. Pinning copies the current hashes from the linked project folder. The run’s working copy must match; these files cannot be changed by agent file tools.
Recipe.filesNeedServer: Criteria files require a local server and a trusted project folder.
Recipe.invalid: Check the candidate, reviewer and limits before pinning.
Recipe.changed: The recipe or criteria changed while saving. Review the current settings and try again.

RuntimeRecovery.scope: Continues a stopped single-agent Run in a new Run with its remaining budget. Native extensions, teams and loops are not supported. The source Run is kept.
RuntimeRecovery.empty: No verified runtime checkpoint. Send a new request to continue from the existing results.
RuntimeRecovery.remaining: {calls} model calls and {tokens} output tokens remaining

blockers.unsupported_state: This runtime state cannot be restored.
blockers.criteria_changed: The criteria changed after this checkpoint.
blockers.unsettled_effects: Some effects or model usage are unconfirmed.
blockers.pending_interaction: A question or approval remains unresolved.
blockers.newer_instruction: A newer instruction is missing from this checkpoint.
blockers.newer_external_effect: An external action occurred after this checkpoint.
blockers.model_changed: The model profile or endpoint changed.
blockers.files_changed_or_uncertain: Files changed or a file operation is unconfirmed.
blockers.checkpoint_corrupt: Checkpoint integrity could not be verified.
blockers.already_resumed: This Run already has a continuation.

SessionSearch.title: Search sessions and results
SessionSearch.privacy: Search stays in this local workspace. Private messages are included only when selected.
SessionSearch.failed: Search is unavailable. Retry or rebuild the index.

MessageBranch.description: Start a separate session and Run from this fixed result. Later messages stay in the source branch.
MessageBranch.checkpoint: Continue with the captured context and file checkpoint.
MessageBranch.context_only: Context-only branch: a new request based on this result, without restoring a runtime checkpoint.
MessageBranch.tree: New working copy from checkpoint {tree}. Tracked and unignored files are included.
MessageBranch.budget: New budget: {model} · up to {calls} model calls and {tokens} output tokens.
MessageBranch.unavailable: This checkpoint cannot be branched. Try context-only or inspect the source Run.
MessageBranch.requestDescription: Start this original request in a separate session and Run, using its original team and criteria.
MessageBranch.requestBoundary: Starts at the original request boundary, before any model response.

ProfileContext.threshold: Automatic compaction threshold: estimated tokens greater than {value, number}.
ProfileContext.hint: Blank inherits; zero is explicit. Compaction applies only to Pi SDK harness runs. Pi core applies context only. Provider limits do not change.
ProfileContext.sdk: Pi SDK policy frozen for this Run. Zero does not disable compaction or guarantee removal of all history.
ProfileContext.legacy: This Pi core execution applies context only; compaction settings are unsupported and not applied.
ProfileContext.mock: Recorded for a simulated Run; no real model compaction is performed.
ProfileContext.unknown: No context policy was recorded. Current settings cannot reconstruct historical values.

warning.legacy_inconsistent: Legacy defaults are inconsistent and preserved for compatibility. Explicit overrides must satisfy the policy.
warning.reserve_below_output: Summary reserve is below the request output cap. Corral’s permit still sets the final summary output cap.
warning.above_model_limit: Context exceeds the base model limit; the provider may refuse the request.
